versions.subject: Merge PR #5116 from @Neo23x0 - Add rules and updates related to Cleo exploitation
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\javaw.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
        - 'Harmony'
        - 'lexicom'
        - 'VersaLex'
        - 'VLTrader'
    Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'powershell'
        - ' -enc '
        - ' -EncodedCommand'
        - '.Download'
condition: selection
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\javaw.exe" ParentCommandLine IN ("*Harmony*", "*lexicom*", "*VersaLex*", "*VLTrader*") Image="*\\cmd.exe" CommandLine IN ("*powershell*", "* -enc *", "* -EncodedCommand*", "*.Download*")
